description: Groq provides high-speed inference for open-source and proprietary large language models through an OpenAI-compatible REST API. Developers use documented Chat Completions, Responses, audio (speech-to-text/text-to-speech), models, batch, and file APIs, plus related endpoints; available model IDs change and should be taken from GET /openai/v1/models or the console models list (e.g. Llama and other currently listed models). Authentication uses a Bearer API key; free and paid tiers include rate limits that vary by model and plan.
resolution_notes: description: auditor correct. Official docs (https://console.groq.com/docs and API reference) document Chat Completions, Responses, audio, models, batch, files, etc.; no embeddings endpoint in the current reference. Current model catalog does not feature Mixtral/Gemma as typical live models—use the models endpoint for IDs. Removed embeddings and retired Mixtral/Gemma examples; listed currently documented API surfaces and pointed to live models. Evidence: https://console.groq.com/docs , https://console.groq.com/docs/api-reference , https://console.groq.com/docs/models
